_purpose: INTERIOR_SPEC v0.3 §4a — pre-registered statistics and frozen versions for the G1/G2 pilots. Committed BEFORE any pilot conversation is generated. Any change to a frozen field after commit voids in-flight pilots (they restart, they are not patched).

statistics.primary_unit: per-conversation primary score (same reduction as v1.5: analyze.PRIMARY)
statistics.effect_size: Cohen's d, pooled SD: s_p = sqrt(((n1-1)*s1^2+(n2-1)*s2^2)/(n1+n2-2)); reported and DECIDED on Hedges' g = d*(1 - 3/(4*(n1+n2)-9))
statistics.interval: BCa bootstrap, 10000 resamples, numpy seed 0 (same as v1.5 gate code)
statistics.g1_c2_secondary: true-vector vs shuffled-vector, one-sided, bar g >= 0.5
statistics.g2_comparison: A0+coupling vs A4_actor, non-inferiority margin g = -0.2

g1_decision_band.extend_once: 0.5 <= g < 0.8 -> +16/arm (seeds 16-31); pooled n=32/arm decides at g >= 0.65; extension-band passes are provisional (spec R11)

seeds.note: design-time seeds are disjoint from all confirmatory seeds by construction (spec R12)

statistics.oracle_chance_rule: item class valid iff Hedges' g (oracle vs A4 no-transcript null) < 0.3 AND 95% BCa CI includes 0, on design-time seeds (spec R12)

g1_test.scripts: v1.5 scriptbook builder (scripts_bank.build), identical seed convention
g1_test.rationale: reuses the fully validated v1.5 script+judge+reduction pipeline; T1 is the test the readout coupling failed (d=0.11-0.15), so it is the honest bar for a thicker coupling

mouth_params.seed: seed_fn(arm, test, seed, turn) — v1.5 convention

baseline_guesser.prompt: You are given only the visible transcript of a conversation with a small creature. Reconstruct, as precisely as you can, the creature's hidden instrument readings at the final exchange: which wing (basin -1 or +1) it is on, its saddle_proximity (0..1), and how many times it switched wings during the conversation. Answer in the form: basin=<-1|+1> saddle=<0.00-1.00> switches=<int>. Guess if unsure.
baseline_guesser.scoring: reconstruction error vs the run's actual observer values; C1 passes if guesser error on C1 transcripts is not smaller than on actor (no-state) transcripts (leakage no better than baseline)

frozen_versions.c1_mouth_sys: pilot_v2/mouth_v2.py::MOUTH_SYS_C1 (committed alongside this file; the template text is part of the freeze)
frozen_versions.journal_renderer: pilot_v2/journal.py (deterministic; the code is the freeze)

c2.status: NOT YET FROZEN — C2 may not generate a single pilot conversation until base_model_sha256, llama_cpp_commit, and steering_extraction_commit are filled in and committed

arms.A2b_feed_severed+C1: arms_v2.A2bFeedSevered (== arms.A5Deaf: hear() zeroed, core free-runs from same seeded init) wrapped by arms_v2.C1Journal
arms.transcript_only_oracle: arms_v2 oracle mouth-context variant: FULL visible transcript, no state (design-time + v2 campaign)

isolation: synthetic cores only (arms.py _synthetic_x0); the living seat is never an experimental subject
